I am a son of Liberator and I can't vow to intimidation and threats from those who want to hijack the history of South Sudan 

By Journalist Emmanuel Malual Makuach 

 I have lived as an independent writer against bad things in South Sudan and I never thought of joining the opposition groups due to your continuous threats on my life.

I lost my father, Makuach Anyar Dhuor to the Liberation Struggle of South Sudan and I feel part and parcel of the establishment of South Sudan as an independent country.

Despite being part of the history of liberation and consequent independence of South Sudan,I continue to face threats from the same government.

On 25 January 2026, I lost my veteran mother, Mary Nyibol and I didn't have an opportunity to send her off. Unfortunately I was blocked from attending her burialbin South Sudan.

In the last few days,speculations have run high surrounding the security threats in my life over an unknown reason.

Henceforth,I have never taken it seriously because I have never attacked personalities.

On the other hand, I know only two individuals from Lakes State who have been after me for a very long time and family and friends are alerted to take note of these latest security threats in case of anything to me.

These people are very ungrateful to recognize by solidarity with SSPDF forces who were trapped in North Jonglei State.

My roles were visible to the families and friends of those who were trapped in northern Jonglei regarding the fate of their sons and daughters. 

I did the similar volunteer work regarding the incidences in Nasir, Pajut, and Akobo Garrisons Massacre 

Additionally , I was advised by some people not to  post something positive about the SSPDF in Frontlines because it helps increase their morale. However , I stood my ground and kept supporting the SSPDF while I didn't know this would be a payback from the same security I stood with.

Martin Elia Lomoro himself wrote the so-called "Sugarcoated Lifting of Travel Restrictions" which is exactly opposite to reality and gave it to President Kiir for approval and announcement. Now the same thing he wrote will be imposed on him accordingly!

BREAKING NEWS

South Sudan President Salva Kiir has announced a major cabinet reshuffle, relieving Martin Elia Lomuro of his duties as Minister of Cabinet Affairs. In a decree broadcast on state television, Kiir appointed Bol Wek Agoth to replace Elia, effective immediately.

In a related development, Angelo Ngot Mayar has been appointed Caretaker Governor of Warrap State, filling the vacancy left by Bol Wek Agoth, who was relieved from the governorship to take up the cabinet portfolio.

Additionally, President Kiir has appointed Hussein Abdelbagi Akol as Advisor for International Relations and Foreign Affairs. Abdelbagi, who previously served as Vice President, takes on the new advisory role in a move seen as part of ongoing government restructuring.

The decrees, issued late wednesday, take effect immediately. No official reason was given for the changes, the reshuffling came shortly after Dr Martin Elia Lomoro issued a circular assigning the caretaker ministers to act in the ministries whose ministers have not been appointed.

Theft at Mrs. Nyandur Makam’s Residence in Juba Raises Questions Over Torture and Accountability

A theft involving an estimated US$150,000 in cash has been reported at Mrs. Vicky Nyandur’s residence in Juba while she was in Turkey.

Several suspects have been apprehended following the incident. Reports of their torture have raised serious human rights concerns. The authorities must ensure their safety and guarantee that they are treated in accordance with the law.

The incident also raises questions about the source of such a large amount of cash and whether the relevant authorities should investigate its origin. Nyandur has been stealing public funds and now she is endangering lives of innocent young people she falsely accused. She should be careful with her ruthless actions threatening lives of innocent people because stolen things sometimes can also go easily the same way she looted them.

Law enforcement agencies should investigate the theft, examine the source of the money, and ensure that anyone responsible for torture or other unlawful acts is held accountable.

Justice must prevail, and no one should be above the law.

‎By Barnaba Magok Mabor 
‎
‎On date 2/Sep/2026, the Board Of Directors, SSBC made unlawful suspension of SSBC Managing Director Hon John Madol. The Board of Directors is an oversight body that tasks by law to supervise all activities of the Managing Director. 
‎
‎The Powers and Functions of Board of Directors are well-written in Broadcasting Corporation Act, 2013. The Board of Directors took only one Month in the Office and decided to remove the Managing Director. 
‎
‎It proves that the Board of Directors was brought for mission intended by the Hon Minister of Information, Hon Ateny Wek Ateny. It was not brought to strengthen the SSBC. They were brought as Committee to do the interest of the Minister. 
‎
‎Hon Minister of Information violated the process of appointment of the Board of Directors, the Board's Members must have qualifications in fields of Broadcasting, Law, Education, Technology , Journalism, and Labour Issues in accordance with S8(6) of the Broadcasting Corporation Act, 2013. 
‎
‎The Board of Directors violated the Broadcasting Corporation Act, 2013 wholly. There was an abi initio from very beginning. And I thought Hon Minister who happened to be legally minded person would note it before he further to form the Committee for an inquiry into matters of suspension. 
‎
‎When the case is wrongly began, as a legal minded person, you resort to de Novo leaving out all messes and begin the case afresh but Hon Ateny Wek Ateny failed to do it. It's an interest over law. The mission Board was tasked by Hon Ateny Wek Ateny is going on. 
‎
‎However, I cannot blame Hon Ateny Wek Ateny because he is not a Lawyer. But a Paralegal Diploma holder, in UK, if you're discontinued when pursuing your LLB. I meant when you failed. You can be discontinued and given a little chance to study Diploma in Paralegal. 
‎
‎When later graduate, you will be working as Clerk in a Court, you cannot be a Lawyer. It's a case of current Minister of Information, if he violates any law. It will not surprise me. He is not a professional Lawyer. If I were the Minister of Information, I would have dismissed the suspension issued by Board of Directors and told them to follow the law rightly. 
‎
‎The Board of Directors violated S8(3), S12 and other Sections of the Broadcasting Corporation Act, 2013. The Board of Directors need time to study an Act well so that when they decide to do their work. They will not violate the Act. 
‎
‎And proven shows that Hon Ateny Wek Ateny has interest over this case. The way he selected the Board of Directors. Only Awiel has 3 Members of the Board while Board of Directors comprised of 9 Members. As if it's called Awiel Broadcasting Corporation not South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation anymore. 
‎
‎Media Authority is also in that shape. Hon Ateny Wek Ateny talks different and does different! He assumed to be an activist who had been advocating for change not change of leadership but change on how to work. Currently, he is doing different thing in office. Nepotism has captured him alive. 
‎
‎Conclusion, I urge you to continue doing what you want to do in this matter but bear in mind that it's not Dr. Benjamin Bol Mel or Gen Malong Awan issue. In Lakes State, we think really. Hon John Madol Panther will change you in your office as successor. 
‎
‎Because there is an adage which says "what goes around comes around!". I made a thorough research about what you're doing in the office. You want to install your backyard person. Your people blamed you that you don't empower people. 
‎
‎Now, you are doing it wrongly. You must use necessary application to do the interest of your people not through bulldozing. 
‎
‎The author is a Law student, University of Juba. And a former Commissioner of Human Rights Commission, Lakes State. 
‎
‎He can be reached at barnabamagok2014@gmail.com
